name: arrendamiento
description: Rentals without an app, for landlords: rent collected from the bank statements, services and property tax, maintenance and warranties, deposits and increases — everything pending in one list.

stays_local: bank statements (PDF), leases, receipts and bills: the agent is told never to open them
names, account and card numbers in the statements (mxbank replaces them with pseudonyms before anything else sees them)
the memory file (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
agent_sees: deposits and charges: date, amount, type, anonymized bank description and account pseudonym
the owner's labels for properties and tenants, the lease terms, recurring items, repairs and their costs
the providers' contacts, only as the owner gives them
everything the owner types in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: not opening documents is an instruction to the agent; host deny permissions reduce the risk but do not remove it
what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms
the memory file is not encrypted
the INPC is not looked up online: the owner gives its values
this is not legal or tax advice
